name: Gatekeepers
overview: Scripture presents gatekeepers as faithful servants entrusted with guarding the entrances of God's holy places, as seen in the detailed listings of their families and duties in Ezra and Nehemiah. Their role was vital in maintaining the security and sanctity of the temple and city gates, reflecting a broader spiritual vigilance exemplified by watchmen who never cease their watch (Isaiah 62:6). Psalm 84:10 highlights the honor and devotion associated with this position, valuing even the lowly role of a doorkeeper in God's house above dwelling among the wicked. Together, these verses emphasize the gatekeepers' commitment to protecting and preserving the worship and holiness of God's people.
